title: Concept: Content security policy allows scripts from any host
description: A script-src directive that names a wildcard source in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A wildcard source lets any host supply script, so an injected tag or a compromised third party runs with the page's origin no matter what the allowlist was meant to say.
applicability: Deployments that render a script-src directive that names a wildcard source into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A wildcard source lets any host supply script, so an injected tag or a compromised third party runs with the page's origin no matter what the allowlist was meant to say.
